recap.headline: Adam Silver Dez Nuts Pickups Run the League
recap.subhead: Four waiver moves flipped a 5-5 tie into 6-3 while Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw left Norman Powell on the pine.

zingers.line: Adam Silver Dez Nuts' manager added Alex Caruso, De'Anthony Melton, Bennett Stirtz and Malik Monk, and those four turned 5-5 into 6-3 on DREB and ST.

zingers.team: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw
zingers.line: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw left Norman Powell and his 18 points on the bench, gifting DREB and ST and a 5-5 tie.
Suggs to be you cut Jrue Holiday for Jaylin Williams, and Holiday has 44 points and 17 assists for Zero Fox Given since.
Nova Knicks sit at 2-7 while Naji Marshall and Caleb Wilson warmed the bench, a 5-5 matchup thrown away on a schedule of one.
LeParth James' Paul Reed, Kris Dunn and Santi Aldama turned a 4-6 deficit into a 5-4 lead, then Deni Avdija bricked 6-of-12.
MONSTARS ☄️ trail Zero Fox Given 4-7 with eight starts left to their twelve, and the brick of the day is theirs.
Thug Life dropped Aaron Wiggins for Daniss Jenkins, and Wiggins has 44 points and eight threes for Suggs to be you since.

night: Jayson Tatum went for 34 PTS, 8 REB, 9 AST and 5 3PTM for theInfamous, the best line of the night.
Trae Young shot 7-16 for 23 PTS and 10 AST, the night's worst brick, and he dragged theInfamous down in FG% too.
Jonathan Kuminga managed 17 PTS and 8 REB on 5-12 FG for Nova Knicks, who lost the night 2-7.
Morez Johnson Jr. had 13 PTS and 17 REB on 5-8 FG and is still on the wire. Luguentz Dort dropped 25 PTS and 5 3PTM, also still on the wire.
Gopher Gold won the night 8-2 over White Mambas, the biggest margin on the board. White Mambas finished 2-8.
